description: This file defines the ClientStreamingProviderRuntime class, which implements IStreamProviderRuntime and ILifecycleParticipant. It manages stream pub/sub, stream directory, lifecycle participation, and extension binding within Orleans streaming clients.

classes.name: ClientStreamingProviderRuntime
classes.description: Implements runtime management for client streaming providers, handling pub/sub, stream directory, lifecycle, and extension binding.

methods.name: ClientStreamingProviderRuntime
methods.description: Constructor initializing pub/sub and stream directory components.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the stream directory, optionally cleaning up resources.

methods.name: ExecutingEntityIdentity
methods.description: Returns the identity of the current runtime client.

methods.name: BindExtension
methods.description: Binds or retrieves extensions for the client context.

methods.name: PubSub
methods.description: Returns specific pub/sub implementations based on pubSubType.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes this runtime to lifecycle events for startup/shutdown handling.
